Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting QNAP device files by moving them into password-protected 7zip archives using the built-in 7zip utility
Exploitation of vulnerabilities (notably CVE-2020-36195) to remotely execute commands on QNAP devices
Use of password-protected 7-zip archives to lock files
Demanding ransom payment via Tor payment site to obtain unique passwords for decryption
Attack Vector: Exploitation of QNAP vulnerabilities (notably CVE-2020-36195 SQL Injection Vulnerability in Multimedia Console and Media Streaming Add-On)
Remote command execution to run 7zip command-line utility to encrypt files
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of numerous '7z' processes in QNAP Resource Monitor
Ransom note file named '!!!READ_ME.txt' containing unique client key
7z.log file containing 7zip command lines with passwords
